actual project screen · property discovery Jagruti
02The challenge

A complex product, unfamiliar to most investors.

Propenize combines real estate, investing, KYC, escrow, wallets and tokenization into one experience.

My challenge was to turn that complexity into an interface that felt familiar, understandable and trustworthy.

Real estateKYC
TokenizationWallet
Digital investmentEscrow
Investor portfolioTokens

06Three design decisions

Three decisions shaped the experience.

01

Make property discovery familiar.

Instead of creating a completely new interaction model, I used familiar product-listing and product-detail patterns.

Property listingfilters + comparable cards
properties
Property detaildetail before commitment
property detail
02

Turn property data into an investment decision.

I prioritized the information investors need to evaluate a property before committing.

  1. 01Expected returns1
  2. 02Financials2
  3. 03Investment calculator3
  4. 04Documents4
property detail
Property detail screen. The numbered list shows the order of priority.
03

Make checkout feel like buying an investment.

“Make it feel like buying stocks.”

Rather than introducing a new interaction model, I used patterns investors already understand.

  1. Investment amount
  2. Expected tokens
  3. Expected return
  4. Continue

10Reflection

What I learned

Designing Propenize taught me that a financial product can't be designed from screens alone. I had to understand the system behind the interface how ownership, money, compliance and investment decisions connect.

What I'd do differently

Challenge the initial business flow earlier and validate assumptions before moving into UI.
